qmc6309_init.tooltip: Starts the QMC6309 (I2C 0x7C, falls back to 0x2C) on the board’s I2C pins; scans the bus first so a cold start is detected. Put it in setup

qmc6309_read.tooltip: Heading 0–360° (hard-iron offsets removed, declination added; keep the board level); X/Y/Z are raw field counts. Reads within 10 ms share one sample

qmc6309_calibrate.tooltip: Hard-iron calibration: turn the board flat a few full circles meanwhile; the new offsets apply at the end. The program waits during calibration

qmc6309_declination.tooltip: Local magnetic declination, east positive and west negative; it is added to the heading to point at true north

qmc6309_set_offsets.message0: QMC6309 hard-iron offsets X %1 Y %2 Z %3
qmc6309_set_offsets.tooltip: Set offsets from an earlier calibration (for example read back from storage at boot) to skip calibrating every time

qmc6309_offset.tooltip: The offset in use; after calibrating, store it and set it back next boot with the offsets block

qmc6309_ok.tooltip: Whether the latest reading succeeded; on failure the last good values are kept
